description: Returns an ICS calendar feed URL with the Act 60 compliance dates for a segment and regime, each event citing its rule. No login and no contact; the URL holds only the segment, regime, decree year and language.

decree_year.description: Year the decree was obtained, if known. Starts the donation from the second tax year and dates rules that count from the decree.

locale.description: Language of the calendar text; default the language of the conversation.

regime.description: pre2027: decree applied for by December 31, 2026; post2027: applied for from January 1, 2027; both: rows of either regime.

segment.description: individual: a decree holder; chapter3: an export services business; all: both lists.

name: calendar_feed

ics_url.description: ICS feed URL to subscribe to in a calendar app.

webcal_url.description: The same feed with the webcal scheme.

title: Act 60 compliance calendar feed
